# The Hummingbird Nest website

Website for [The Hummingbird Nest](https://www.thehummingbirdnest.org), a DIR Floortime® practice in La Cañada Flintridge, CA.

A fast static site with a small Cloudflare Worker in front of it:

* **Static pages** are generated by a small Node build (`site/build.mjs`) into `dist/`.
* **The contact form** posts from the browser to [FormSubmit](https://formsubmit.co), which emails it to the practice (no server code; see DEPLOY.md, section 4).
* **The Worker** (`src/worker.js`) serves `dist/` with Workers Static Assets, redirects the bare domain to `www`, adds security headers and caching, sends `/edit` to the blog in Pages CMS (a temporary redirect, for the practice), and serves the home page Instagram feed (`/api/instagram`) from Behold.
* **Motion** uses GSAP ScrollTrigger and Lenis, bundled with esbuild. Everything degrades gracefully: without JavaScript the site is complete, and visitors who turn on "reduce motion" get a calm, static version.

Deployment and DNS steps are in **[DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md)**.

## Commands

```bash
npm install          # once
npm run build        # process any new photos, then build dist/ (also checks for dashes, missing alt text, broken links and search titles)
npm run dev          # build, then run the site and Worker locally at http://localhost:8787
npm run images       # only the photo step (add -- --force to re-encode every photo)
npm run deploy       # build and deploy from your machine (normally every push to main publishes; see DEPLOY.md, section 1)
```

## Project layout

```
.pages.yml            Pages CMS editing screens (blog, team, testimonials, FAQ)
site/
  config.mjs          Phone, email, address, social links, booking link, analytics switches
  build.mjs           The build (pages, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, manifest, output checks)
  images.mjs          Responsive image generator (AVIF + WebP, social share cards, icons)
  deploy.mjs          Production deploy step on Cloudflare (wrangler deploy, retried on brief API errors)
  content/
    posts/            Blog posts, one Markdown file each
    team.json         Team members (About page)
    testimonials.json Testimonials (home and service pages)
    faq.json          FAQ (About and service pages)
  data/
    services.mjs      The five service pages (titles, copy, photos)
    content.mjs       Loads the content files above; home page blocks and gallery
    images.json       Image sizes, written by the photo step
  pages/              Page templates (home, about, services, resources and blog, contact, legal, 404)
  lib/                Layout (header, menus, footer), shared sections, SEO and CMS helpers
  styles/             CSS (base tokens, layout, sections, pages, motion)
  scripts/            Browser JavaScript (motion, menus, blog carousel, contact form, Instagram feed)
  images/             Master photos (uploads from the CMS land here too)
  static/             Copied as is into dist/ (generated images, video, favicon)
src/worker.js         Cloudflare Worker
wrangler.jsonc        Worker configuration
```

## Editing content

* **The practice edits in Pages CMS:** blog posts, team, testimonials and FAQ. See DEPLOY.md, section 7. Every save publishes in about two minutes.
* **Contact details, links, analytics:** `site/config.mjs`.
* **Services:** `site/data/services.mjs`. Each entry is one page; URLs match the old site so search rankings carry over.
* **Blog:** posts appear in a carousel on the Resources page (`/resources#blog`), with Children, Teens and Adults tabs at their original `/blog-categories/...` addresses. The old `/blog` address redirects there.
* **Blog posts by hand:** add a Markdown file to `site/content/posts/`. The file name becomes the address (`my-post.md` is `/post/my-post`).

  ```markdown
  ---
  title: "Post title"
  draft: false                # true keeps the post off the site
  category: children          # children, teens or adults
  date: 2026-11-01
  image: /images/post-my-photo.jpg
  imageAlt: "Describe the photo for screen reader users"
  description: "One or two sentences for Google and social sharing, under 160 characters."
  ---

  Your post, in Markdown. Use ## for section headings.
  ```

  Put the photo in `site/images/`. The build creates every size automatically.

Content from the CMS is made safe automatically: dashes become commas, spaces or "to" (a range written with a long dash or a spaced hyphen, such as "ages 3–7" or "ages 3 - 7", reads "ages 3 to 7"), a missing photo falls back to the blog header photo, and a mistyped link or broken post is reported as a warning instead of stopping the site from publishing.

## House rules (enforced by the build)

* **Copy matches the original site word for word.** Page text is written exactly as it was on the old Webflow site (hyphens included); only the dash rule below is applied when the page is built.
* **No dashes or em dashes in visible text.** The build fails if a hyphen, en dash or em dash appears in page text, alt text or meta descriptions (web and email addresses are exempt). Phone numbers are written as `(626) 765 1724`. Content edited in the CMS is fixed automatically instead. Hyphens inside words show exactly as the old site did ("1-on-1 In-School Support", "parent-child", ages "2-25") because `keepWordHyphens` is `true` in `site/config.mjs`; dashes used as punctuation still become commas. Set it to `false` to turn word hyphens into spaces ("2-25" becomes "2 to 25"). Words listed in `keepHyphensIn` in the same file (currently "1-on-1", at the client's request) always keep their hyphens.
* **Every image needs alt text** (or `alt=""` when purely decorative).
* **Internal links must resolve** to a real page or file.
* **Every page has one `h1` and its own search title and description** (title up to 70 characters, description 50 to 165). A blog post that breaks this is reported as a warning instead.
* No dot or pulse graphics, and no lines or hyphens next to headings.

## Accessibility

Built to WCAG 2.2 AA: semantic landmarks, skip link, visible focus states, keyboard support for every menu and carousel, a native `<dialog>` mobile menu (focus is trapped and Escape closes it), accessible form errors, a pause button for the hero video, and full `prefers-reduced-motion` support. All pages pass axe-core with zero violations on desktop and mobile. See `/accessibility` on the site.

## SEO

Unique titles and descriptions, canonical URLs, Open Graph and Twitter cards with JPEG share images, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`, and schema.org structured data (LocalBusiness with its list of services, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Service, Person, Book, FAQPage, BlogPosting). All original URLs are preserved, and `/about/` or `/about.html` style addresses redirect permanently to the one real address.

Page copy is fixed (see the house rules), so search wording lives in the parts visitors do not see on the page:

* **Search titles and descriptions.** Each service has a `seoTitle` and `description` in `site/data/services.mjs`; other pages set `title` and `description` in their file under `site/pages/`. A title names the service and the place (La Cañada Flintridge for what happens at the office, the Los Angeles area for work in schools). The site name is added when it fits; set `titleTag` on a page to write the whole title yourself. Keep titles near 60 characters and descriptions under 160, which is what Google shows.
* **Structured data** is built in `site/lib/seo.mjs` from `site/config.mjs`, the services list and the team bios, so it stays in step with the pages.
* **The sitemap** only gives a "last changed" date where the date is real (blog posts, and the pages that list them).

After launch, the steps outside this repository (Search Console, Google Business Profile) are in DEPLOY.md, section 6.
